method: Four parallel research agents (open-weights / leaderboards / headlines+policy / top-story+concept) ran live WebSearch+WebFetch for the window June 22-28, 2026. Only SOLID multi-sourced or primary-sourced claims were drafted; allegations are attributed; THIN/UNVERIFIED items were excluded or hedged. Weekday and arithmetic self-check applied post-draft.

claims.claim: Liquid AI released LFM2.5 (230M params, on-device, day-one llama.cpp/MLX/vLLM/SGLang/ONNX; ~213 tok/s on a Galaxy S25 Ultra, ~42 tok/s on a Raspberry Pi 5; Liquid says it beats Qwen3.5-0.8B and Gemma 3 1B on instruction-following/extraction)
claims.note: Performance numbers attributed to Liquid ('Liquid says/claims') on air. Anchored as 'yesterday' (Sat 6/27 relative to Sun 6/28).

claims.claim: Alibaba's Qwen team released Qwen-AgentWorld-35B-A3B, an Apache-2.0 MoE 'language world-model' (35B total / 3B active) for training agents; benchmark + GGUF quants shipped alongside
Sakana AI launched Fugu, a closed orchestration/router service across third-party frontier models (not open weights), $5/M in, $30/M out

Cursor study on SWE-bench Pro: 63% of audited successful resolutions were retrieval of the known fix (upstream lookup + git-history mining) across 731 trajectories; sealing git history + cutting internet dropped Opus 4.8 Max 87.1%->73.0% and Cursor Composer 2.5 74.7%->54.0%
claims.note: 57%/9% sub-split kept qualitative on air (does not cleanly sum to 63). Drop figures are the primary-sourced numbers and stated exactly.

claims.claim: Epoch AI added nine new external benchmarks to its hub
claims.note: The nine are not enumerated on air (page does not list them).

claims.claim: OpenAI previewed GPT-5.6 (Sol/Terra/Luna) as a government-gated limited preview (~20 partner orgs, after sharing with the US government); not in ChatGPT during preview; no SWE-bench Pro figure published
claims.note: Cyber-capability framing attributed to OpenAI. Terminal-Bench 88.8/91.9 figures were THIN/secondary -> NOT stated on air.

claims.claim: OpenAI and Broadcom unveiled 'Jalapeno', OpenAI's first custom inference ASIC (reticle-sized, ~9-month design-to-tape-out, OpenAI models assisted layout), targeting ~half inference cost/token vs current GPUs, deployment by end of 2026
claims.note: '~50% cheaper' framed as 'roughly half', not exact.

claims.claim: OpenAI expanded its Daybreak security program with 'Patch the Planet'; 30+ open-source projects (incl. cURL, Go, Python) signed on for model-driven vuln finding/fixes
Bloomberg reported Google is poised to lose two more senior AI researchers to Anthropic, part of a run of DeepMind departures
claims.note: Researchers not named on air; shaky 'four in six days' framing omitted.

claims.claim: Anthropic told a US Senate committee that Alibaba ran the 'largest known distillation attack' on Claude: ~25,000 fraudulent accounts, ~28.8M exchanges Apr 22-Jun 5 2026 against a preview of its newest model, alleging Chinese-government complicity
claims.note: ALLEGATION, framed as such throughout ('Anthropic says/alleges'); underlying letter dated 6/10, broke in news cycle 6/24-25; Alibaba has not conceded.
